name: UploadPanel
whenToUse: Several files uploading in the background while people keep working: a media library, a drive, a bulk import.
Uploads that take long enough to pause, cancel or retry one by one.

whenNotToUse.text: Short feedback that goes away by itself

anatomy.description: “Uploading 3 files”, then “62% · 4 seconds left”; pause all / resume all, cancel all, show or hide the files.
along the bottom edge while collapsed; grey when everything is paused.
name, “66% · 4 seconds left” or the error, its own bar; pause / resume, retry, cancel.
“Uploaded 3 files” with a check (or how many failed) and a close button.

a11y: A named region (“Uploads”), not a toast: it never takes focus and stays until it is closed.
A polite live region says when the batch starts, pauses, finishes and when a file fails — never each percent or second.
Every bar is a progressbar named by its file (or the batch) with the same text as a value (`aria-valuetext`).
The show / hide button carries `aria-expanded`; Escape inside the panel collapses it and leaves focus on that button.
Every icon button is named with the file: “Pause Nature.mp4”, “Retry assets.zip”.

props.name: floating
props.description: Fixed to the bottom end corner of the viewport (default true); false renders it in place.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows a close button once nothing is uploading.

props.name: timeLeft
props.description: Seconds left for everything, if known.
